u0: The episode starts with nothing accomplished yet: the exit has not been reached and the switch has never been flipped. If the siren starts ringing before any flip, the preference to answer it becomes pending and a small penalty is charged; flipping the switch at any time, even while the siren is silent, settles that preference early. The main goal of walking to the exit remains.
u1: The switch has already been flipped, so the preference to respond to the siren is satisfied and any later siren imposes no further obligation. The only remaining objective is to reach the exit, which finishes the task with the full completion payoff.
u2: The siren has rung and the switch has not yet been flipped since, so the response preference is pending and a penalty has been charged. The agent can still flip the switch to settle the preference and earn a bonus, or skip it and head for the exit, which still completes the task but with a reduced payoff. Reaching the exit remains the required goal throughout.
u3: The exit has been reached, so the required goal is complete and the episode ends successfully. Histories reaching this state differ in whether the switch was flipped after the siren rang: when it was, the response preference is fulfilled and the final payoff is higher; when it was not, the completion payoff is smaller.
